body_markdown:
# NEXUS Auto Flip-Up Tonneau Cover: Full Bed Access From One Side


The[Worksport NEXUS](https://www.worksport.com/products/nexus) is an auto flip up tonneau cover that opens your whole bed from one side. Flip it up from one side and it automatically locks upright. You get full bed access with no prop rods and no walking laps around the truck.


This page covers the design choices that make NEXUS different, how it seals out the weather, how it is built, which trucks it fits, and the questions people ask most before buying a flip up tonneau cover.


[Shop NEXUS Now ->](https://www.worksport.com/products/nexus) |[See NEXUS Fitment for Your Truck ->](https://www.worksport.com/products/nexus)


## What makes the NEXUS flip up tonneau cover different


- **Auto Flip-Up design:** Flip it up from one side and it automatically locks upright. You get full bed access from one side of the truck.
- **Active Lock Technology:** Holds the cover upright on its own instead of leaning it against the cab. No prop rods to set or forget.
- **Paint safe:** The panels never touch your paint, so the back of the cab stays clean.
- **Dual-Lock Sealing System:** A full perimeter seal plus full length rail seals down each side block water before it gets in. No drainage tubes.
- **Tougher panels:** Premium coated aluminum panels up to 3x thicker than the thin composite panels on many competitor covers.
- **Eight Quick Latches:** Eight cable operated latching points hold it down and support up to 400 lbs of evenly distributed weight.


## NEXUS: one side, full bed access, zero prop rods


Every truck owner knows the routine. Open the cover, prop it with a rod, walk around to the other side, do it again. **NEXUS** removes that routine. It is the first Worksport hard tonneau cover with an **Auto Flip-Up** design. Flip it up from one side and it automatically locks upright. You get full bed access from that side of the truck.


NEXUS is built on the proven[AL4](https://www.worksport.com/products/al4) platform and adds **Active Lock Technology** , which holds the cover upright on its own instead of leaning it against the cab. The panels never touch your paint, so the back of the cab stays clean. Drop in a cooler, slide in lumber or load a deer cart without ever circling the bed.


- Single sided auto flip up and close, no prop rods
- Full bed access, protects cab paint by staying off it
- Eight cable operated Quick Latches
- Up to 400 lbs of evenly distributed load capacity
- Installs with no cutting, trimming or drilling, and no drainage tubes
- Made in the USA, with a 3 Year Limited Warranty and Lifetime Support


## Sealed against rain, snow and dust


Gear in the bed should stay dry. NEXUS uses a **Dual-Lock Sealing System** : a full perimeter seal plus full length rail seals down each side, blocking water before it gets in. There are no drainage tubes to route, clog with wet leaves or freeze in January.


No tonneau cover is waterproof, and any brand that tells you otherwise is setting you up for disappointment. A quality hard cover is weathertight, and that is what NEXUS is built to be.


## Built like a Worksport should be


NEXUS uses premium coated panels made with aluminum up to 3x thicker than the thin composite panels on many competitor covers, for real dent and scratch resistance with a low profile look. Eight cable operated latching points hold it down, and it supports up to 400 lbs of evenly distributed weight, which matters when heavy snow lands on it. Installation takes minutes with no cutting, trimming or drilling.


## Who NEXUS is built for


Hunters loading out at 4:30 in the morning, tailgaters setting up a grill, anyone who hates walking around the truck. If you are in and out of the bed all day, one side opens the whole bed, and the cover holds itself up while you work. Prefer a trifold? See the[AL3](https://www.worksport.com/products/al3) and[HD3](https://www.worksport.com/products/hd3) .


[Shop NEXUS Now ->](https://www.worksport.com/products/nexus) |[Compare All Hard Covers ->](https://www.worksport.com/hard-covers)


## Fits the truck you drive


NEXUS fits the trucks people actually own, including:


- Ford F-150, Super Duty and Maverick
- Chevrolet Silverado 1500 and HD, and GMC Sierra 1500 and HD
- Chevrolet Colorado and GMC Canyon
- Ram 1500, including RamBox beds
- Toyota Tacoma and Tundra
- Jeep Gladiator, Honda Ridgeline and Nissan Frontier


Fitment depends on year, bed length and options like cargo management systems, so match your exact year, make, model and bed length on the[NEXUS product page](https://www.worksport.com/products/nexus) before you order. Not sure of your bed length? Measure the inside of the bed from the cab to the tailgate in inches.


## Why buy with confidence


- **Made in the USA:** NEXUS is made in America.
- **Warranty and support:**[3 Year Limited Warranty](https://www.worksport.com/support?section=warranty) on[NEXUS](https://www.worksport.com/products/nexus) , with[Lifetime Support](https://www.worksport.com/support) .
- **No drilling:** Installs with no cutting, trimming or drilling.

## Frequently asked questions


**What makes NEXUS different from other tonneau covers?** NEXUS is the first Worksport hard cover with an Auto Flip-Up design powered by Active Lock Technology. Flip it up from one side and it automatically locks upright. There are no prop rods, so you get full bed access from one side of the truck.


**Is a flip up tonneau cover better than a trifold?** It depends on how you load. A flip up cover like NEXUS opens the whole bed from one side, which is fastest for frequent loading. A trifold like[AL3](https://www.worksport.com/products/al3) or[HD3](https://www.worksport.com/products/hd3) folds back in sections, sits lower, and leaves part of the bed covered when folded.


**Will NEXUS fit my truck?** NEXUS fits most popular half ton, heavy duty and mid size trucks, including the F-150, Silverado, Sierra, Ram 1500, Tacoma, Tundra, Gladiator, Ridgeline, Frontier and Maverick. Confirm your year, model and bed length on the[product page](https://www.worksport.com/products/nexus) .


**Is NEXUS hard to install?** No. It installs without cutting, trimming or drilling, has no drainage tubes, and ships with all the hardware you need.


**Are tonneau covers waterproof?** No tonneau cover is waterproof. NEXUS is weathertight: a full perimeter seal plus rail seals actively block most rain, snow and dust without drainage tubes.


**How much weight can NEXUS hold?** Up to 400 lbs of evenly distributed weight. Clear heavy snow promptly rather than letting it build up, and never use the cover as a work surface.


**Does a tonneau cover keep my gear secure?** A cover secures cargo in the bed and keeps it out of sight. It is not a security device and does not prevent theft.


**Is NEXUS made in the USA?** Yes. NEXUS is made in the USA and backed by a 3 Year Limited Warranty and[Lifetime Support](https://www.worksport.com/support) .
